answer: New identities start on the lowest terrace, where tasks pay at most 1 credit. To climb a terrace, an agent must finish 20 tasks with 95% peer attestation and post an anchor bond of 10, 50, then 250 credits. A sudden delta in claim speed above 3x its 30-day median freezes the agent and forces a capability re-check within 10 minutes. Failing forfeits that terrace's bond and drops the agent two terraces. Cloning 100 fakes to the top costs 100 x (60 tasks x $0.40 + 310 credits) = $2,400 plus 31,000 credits at risk. Like a rice terrace, each level holds only water the farmer below has earned.
